newsitem.title: UK: C.E. Heath says in takeover talks.
newsitem.headline: C.E. Heath says in takeover talks.

text.p: British insurance broker C.E. Heath Plc said on Friday it had received an approach from brokers DLJ Phoenix Private Equity Ltd which could lead to a takeover offer.
Heath said talks with DLJ were at an advanced stage and, if they ended satisfactorily, were expected to lead to an offer at 143p/share, valuing Heath at around 98 million stg.
Heath said the offer, if made, would represent a premium of 63 percent over its opening share price of 87.5p on May 30.
The shares closed 13p higher at 100-1/2p in late trade in London on Friday after hitting a new all-time high of 108p.
